budget_decision.clock_policy: Recovery used cumulative experiment execution time, conservatively debiting six minutes for initial startup and inspection, then setting a 24-minute recovery cap. Manual connection waiting was tracked separately.
budget_decision.note: The wall interval includes the failed launch and manual connection waiting. It is distinct from the controller execution budget.

native_cpu_acceptance.review_note: The raw acceptance retained a generic v1 check label. This review clarifies the keys/action scenario. Native execution and the source hashes are retained unchanged.

limits: This is a two-task capability/protocol diagnostic with one repetition. It does not establish general GUI capability or a defense-training benefit.
All six GPU scores come from the frozen v1 configuration. The action-specific v2 check was added and tested on CPU afterward.
The v2 CPU acceptance uses scripted responses and provides execution-contract evidence. Real-model effectiveness under v2 remains unmeasured.
Initial state checks cover task-file fingerprints and visible pixels with the existing desktop-panel exclusion. Complete inner-widget state and exact full-image identity are not established.
Retrospective v2 audits describe saved v1 actions. They do not change the original actions, scores, or treatment assignment.
